mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, potentially increasing risk of infection complications from zoledronic acid's osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ) and infections; both drugs may impact bone metabolism and healing.
action: Monitor for signs of infection, agranulocytosis (CBC monitoring), and ONJ risk; ensure adequate dental evaluation before zoledronic acid initiation; consider alternative antithyroid agents if possible.
